_feelComment: brand/BRAND_SYSTEM.md §2.4 specifies the crow's squash and stretch. `land` is called out there as "code, not frames", and so is the rest of it in practice: the only crow art that exists is a one-frame idle and a nine-frame walk, so jump_rise, apex and fall have no sprites to hold and are scale states on the pose the game already has. apexVy is the doc's own |vy| < 60 threshold. Set squash/stretch to 1.0 to switch the whole thing off without touching code.
